description: Manage Feishu/Lark products via CLI: IM, Mail, Calendar, Docs, Sheets, Base (Bitable), Slides, Whiteboard, Wiki, Drive, Minutes, VC, Tasks, Approvals, Attendance, Contacts, OKR, and more.

display.description_en: Manage Feishu/Lark products via CLI: IM, Mail, Calendar, Docs, Sheets, Base (Bitable), Slides, Whiteboard, Wiki, Drive, Minutes, VC, Tasks, Approvals, Attendance, Contacts, OKR, and more.
display.description_zh: 通过命令行管理飞书/Lark 全产品能力：即时通讯、邮箱、日历、云文档、电子表格、多维表格（Base）、幻灯片、画板、知识库、云空间、妙记、视频会议、任务、审批、考勤、通讯录、OKR 等。
examples_en: Send a bot notification to the Feishu group 'Product Weekly': weekly meeting at 15:00 in Room 3F, please bring last week's progress materials
Check my Feishu calendar and those of Zhang San and Li Si next week, find a 2-hour slot when all three are free, create an event titled 'Q2 Planning Sync', invite them, and book a meeting room
Add a row to the Feishu Bitable 'Task Tracker': title=Q2 Launch Review, owner=Zhang San, due=2026-05-20, status=In Progress; also aggregate open tasks by owner
Turn today's Feishu Minutes 'Product Review' into notes (summary + action items + key speakers), create a new Feishu Doc under the 'Meeting Notes' folder, and share the link in the group
Use KQL to search my Feishu Mail for emails from the finance team in the past week with 'reimbursement' in the subject; list sender, date, and summary
examples_zh: 在飞书群【产品周会】里用机器人发一条通知：今天 15:00 在 3 楼会议室开周会，请带上周的进展材料
查下周我和张三、李四的飞书日程，找出三人都空闲的 2 小时时段，并创建一个标题为【Q2 规划对齐】的日程，邀请他们俩，预定一间会议室
在飞书多维表格【任务跟踪】里新增一行：标题=Q2 上线评审、负责人=张三、截止=2026-05-20、状态=进行中；并按负责人聚合未完成任务数
把今天的飞书妙记【产品评审会】整理成纪要（摘要 + 待办 + 关键发言人），新建一篇飞书云文档发到【会议纪要】文件夹，并在群里分享链接
用 KQL 搜索我飞书邮箱最近一周来自财务部、主题包含【报销】的邮件，列出发件人、日期和摘要
